description: This Java source file defines the 'SubjectModifiedStrategy' class, a final class that extends an abstract strategy for handling subject modified events in Eclipse Ditto policies. It overrides the 'applyEvent' method to update a policy builder with subject information from the event.

classes.name: SubjectModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles 'SubjectModified' events by updating policy builders with new subject information.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the subject in the policy builder based on the 'SubjectModified' event.
